title: Protocol for large scale whole blood immune monitoring by mass cytometry and Cyto Quality Pipeline
protocol: Thaw frozen donor samples and reference sample from −80°C.
Place tubes on a tube rotator at 4°C until completely thawed (approximately 40 minutes).
Alternatively, thaw samples in cold water bath (∼10°C) with agitation.
Prepare Thaw-lyse buffer by diluting it 1000× to 1× in MilliQ water.
Prepare eleven (11) 15 mL tubes and eleven (11) 5 mL FACS tubes, label them according to the barcoding ID.
Place 100 μm strainers above each 15 mL tube.
Add 5 mL of Thaw-Lyse buffer to each tube, ensuring that the strainer area is wet.
Once fixed blood is thawed, add 2 mL of Thaw-Lyse buffer to each tube.
Close the tubes tightly and mix by inversion.
Transfer the content of the FACS tubes to the corresponding centrifuge tube with the strainer.
Pipet gently to break down clumps if present after thawing.
Wash each FACS tube with 1 mL of Thaw-Lyse buffer to collect all cells and filter through the strainer.
Fill the centrifuge tubes up to 15 mL with Thaw-Lyse buffer, discard the strainers caps.
Incubate on the roller for 10 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge tubes for 10 min at 4°C, 800 g and decant the supernatant.
Repeat lysis using 10 mL of Thaw-Lyse buffer and additional 10 min incubation if pellet is still red.
Wash with 3 mL of CSB (Cell staining buffer), 5 min, 800 g, 4°C.
Decant the supernatant.
Add 2 mL of DPBS and count the cells using an automated cell counter such as a TC20 cell counter.
Transfer 1.5 × 10^6 cells to a labeled FACS tube.
Standardize thawing conditions across all samples in the study, either by thawing them at 4°C using a tube rotator or agitating in water (∼10°C).
Process the samples as soon as they are thawed.
If clumps appear during thawing, pipette the clumps and perform two lysis steps.
Dilute Maxpar® 10× Barcode Perm buffer (BPB) with Maxpar® PBS.
Wash cells with 500 μL of BPB and centrifuge for 5 min at 800 g at 4°C.
Decant the supernatant and vortex gently.
Wash cells with 500 μL of BPB and centrifuge for 5 min at 800 g at 4°C.
Decant the supernatant.
Vortex the pellet gently.
Resuspend in 400 μL of BPB.
Prepare barcodes.
Thaw the barcodes at room temperature (RT).
Spin for 10 s in a microcentrifuge at full speed.
Barcode the samples.
Using a multichannel pipette, resuspend first four barcodes in 100 μL of ice-cold BPB.
Mix well and transfer 100 μL to the FACS tubes containing the cells.
Vortex gently.
Incubate for 20 min at RT.
Wash the tubes with 2 mL CSB, 5 min at 800 g, 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Vortex the pellet.
Repeat washing step twice.
Pool the barcoded samples in a single FACS tube.
Resuspend cells in each tube in 120 μL of CBS and pool all the samples to a new single FACS tube.
Add additional 120 μL of CSB to wash the original tubes and transfer all the remaining cells to the same FACS tube.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 800 g, 4°C.
Decant the supernatant.
Vortex gently.
Thaw one aliquot of the antibody cocktail at 4°C.
Centrifuge the antibody cocktail at 15,000 g for 10 min to sediment antibody aggregates.
Keep the intracellular cocktail on ice until needed.
Stain cell surface.
Add 298.6 μL of CSB to the cells and 31.4 μL of antibody cocktail.
Vortex gently.
Incubate for 30 min at 4°C.
Wash for intracellular staining.
Wash cells with 3 mL of Perm-S buffer.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 800 g, 4°C.
Discard supernatant.
Vortex gently.
Repeat Perm-S wash.
Stain intracellular cytokines.
Add 309.6 μL of Perm-S to the cells and 20.4 μL of antibody cocktail.
Vortex gently.
Incubate for 30 min at 4°C.
Wash cells with 3 mL of CSB.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 800 g, 4°C.
Discard supernatant.
Vortex gently.
Repeat CSB wash.
Stain DNA with Ir.
Calculate the volume of Maxpar® Fix and Perm Buffer needed for Ir staining using the rule 5∗107/mL.
Dilute Ir (500 μM) to a final concentration of 0.125 mM in Maxpar® Fix and Perm Buffer.
Add calculated volume of Ir solution to the cells.
Vortex gently.
Incubate for 30 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge the sample for 5 min at 800 g and 4°C.
Decant the supernatant after centrifugation.
Vortex gently after decanting the supernatant.
Wash cells with 3 ml of CST buffer.
Centrifuge again for 5 min at 800 g and 4°C.
Decant the supernatant after washing.
Vortex gently after decanting the supernatant.
Prepare 2% PFA from Pierce™ 16% Formaldehyde stock daily.
Resuspend cells in 2% PFA at a concentration of 1 × 10^7/mL.
Vortex gently and store at 4°C until acquisition.
Use the same acquisition template throughout the project to avoid mislabeling of antibody names.
Prepare a unique naming scheme for the samples and antibody panel in a given study.
Dilute EQ™ Four Element Calibration Beads in MilliQ water to create a 0.1× beads solution.
Sonicate the beads working solution for 10 minutes.
Calculate the volume needed for bead acquisition according to Table 8.
Vortex the beads vigorously before use every time.
Prepare fresh bead solution each time for accurate calibration.
Resuspend cells by vortexing.
Take an aliquot of 200 μL and transfer it to a 5 mL FACS tube containing 1.8 mL of CSB.
Centrifuge at 800 g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant after centrifugation, vortex again.
Wash cells with 2 mL of MilliQ water.
Centrifuge at 800 g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and vortex.
Add 2 mL of MilliQ water.
Vortex the mixture.
Take 10 μL of cell aliquot for cell counting.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 800 g and 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Vortex again.
Resuspend cells in freshly prepared beads at 8 × 10^5/mL.
Introduce the sample name in the CyTOF software.
Acquire each aliquot on a Helios mass cytometer for no longer than 1.5 hours to avoid sample degradation.
Repeat steps until the target number of cells is acquired.
